items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01
items.q: That's where George come got me from. The first recording we made was Gene, William. ... I was so glad with George come back and met that job. ... Tony Perrano, yeah. Then George got seconded in the yard. ... I don't know, I don't know, that's something that George Lewis, that guy can play some kind

I think it's a nice tone too. You see that? I see where George be playing the road register. I'll put that on.
